segments.text: Maintenance and cleaning of the laser, welder 1200 watts.
segments.zh: 激光焊机 1200 瓦的维护与清洁。

segments.text: Clean or replace the lens protector.
segments.zh: 清洁或更换保护镜片。

segments.text: If the laser power decreases and the welding spark weakens,
segments.zh: 如果激光功率下降、焊接火花变弱，

segments.text: the welding head's lens protector may get dirty or damaged.
segments.zh: 可能是焊接头的保护镜片脏了或损坏了。

segments.text: Clean or replace it as needed.
segments.zh: 根据需要清洁或更换它。

segments.text: Please clean or replace the lens protector in a dust-free or relatively clean environment.
segments.zh: 请在无尘或相对洁净的环境中清洁或更换保护镜片。

segments.text: Before operations, clean the welding head with lint-free paper or lint-free cloth
segments.zh: 操作前，先用无尘纸或无尘布清洁焊接头，

segments.text: and wash your hands or wear lint-free gloves.
segments.zh: 并洗手或戴上无尘手套。

segments.text: Remove the cover on the top of the welding head.
segments.zh: 取下焊接头顶部的盖子。

segments.text: Remove the lens protector one.
segments.zh: 取出保护镜片。

segments.text: Check the lens protector.
segments.zh: 检查保护镜片。

segments.text: If the lens protector is dirty, use a cotton swab dipped with alcohol to clean it.
segments.zh: 如果保护镜片脏了，用蘸了酒精的棉签清洁它。

segments.text: Then install it back to the welding head.
segments.zh: 然后把它装回焊接头。

segments.text: If the lens protector is burned or heavily dirty and uncleanable, it needs to be replaced.
segments.zh: 如果保护镜片被烧坏或严重脏污、无法清洁，就需要更换。

segments.text: Keep your hands clean or wear lint-free gloves to remove the gasket and lens protector.
segments.zh: 保持双手清洁或戴上无尘手套，取下密封垫和保护镜片。

segments.text: Take out a new lens protector.
segments.zh: 取出一片新的保护镜片。

segments.text: Do not touch the glass with your fingers or other tools during replacement to prevent dirt.
segments.zh: 更换时不要用手指或其他工具碰触镜片玻璃，以免弄脏。

segments.text: If the glass accidentally gets dirty or dusty, use a cotton swab to clean it.
segments.zh: 如果镜片不小心沾上了污物或灰尘，用棉签清洁它。

segments.text: Remove the protective film on the top.
segments.zh: 撕掉顶部的保护膜。

segments.text: Install the lens protector.
segments.zh: 装上保护镜片。

segments.text: Remove the protective film on the other side.
segments.zh: 撕掉另一面的保护膜。

segments.text: Install the gasket back.
segments.zh: 把密封垫装回去。

segments.text: Install the lens protector back to the welding head.
segments.zh: 把保护镜片装回焊接头。

segments.text: Install the lens protector in the correct direction and press it into place.
segments.zh: 按正确的方向安装保护镜片，并把它按压到位。

segments.text: Calibrate the red spot position for the welding head.
segments.zh: 校准焊接头的红点位置。

segments.text: Calibrate the left or right offset.
segments.zh: 校准左右偏移。

segments.text: If you use the pre-installed welding nozzle for laser welding, perform a left or right offset calibration
segments.zh: 如果你使用预装的焊接喷嘴进行激光焊接，当喷嘴安装正确、

segments.text: when the laser spot deviates left or right from the wire, despite proper nozzle installation.
segments.zh: 激光光斑却向焊丝左侧或右侧偏离时，就要进行左右偏移校准。

segments.text: On the touchscreen of the main unit, tap system settings, machine settings, enter administrator settings.
segments.zh: 在主机触摸屏上，点击“系统设置”、“机器设置”，进入“管理员设置”。

segments.text: Then input the 8 digit password, 8888888.
segments.zh: 然后输入 8 位密码 8888888。

segments.text: To the right of red spot position offset, tap start.
segments.zh: 在“红点位置偏移”右侧，点击“开始”。

segments.text: Then tap the left arrow to decrease the offset and move the red spot leftward.
segments.zh: 然后点击左箭头减小偏移量，使红点向左移动。

segments.text: Tap the right arrow to increase the offset and move the red spot rightward.
segments.zh: 点击右箭头增大偏移量，使红点向右移动。

segments.text: When the center of the red spot falls at the welding wire, tap completed.
segments.zh: 当红点的中心落在焊丝上时，点击“完成”。

segments.text: Calibrate the up or down offset.
segments.zh: 校准上下偏移。

segments.text: When a cutting nozzle is used, the laser beam may strike the nozzle's inner wall, resulting in either blockage or reflection.
segments.zh: 使用切割喷嘴时，激光束可能会打到喷嘴内壁上，导致遮挡或反射。

segments.text: In such cases, perform left or right offset calibration.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，进行左右偏移校准。

segments.text: If the problem persists, reset the red spot position offset to zero and try calibrating the up or down offset.
segments.zh: 如果问题仍然存在，把红点位置偏移重置为零，再尝试校准上下偏移。

segments.text: Welding and cleaning nozzles have larger apertures and typically do not require such adjustment.
segments.zh: 焊接喷嘴和清洗喷嘴的孔径较大，通常不需要这种调整。

segments.text: Insert the hex key into hole 1 or hole 2 and slowly turn the screw while observing the light emitting from the nozzle.
segments.zh: 把内六角扳手插入 1 号孔或 2 号孔，一边慢慢转动螺丝，一边观察喷嘴射出的光。

segments.text: If a clear red spot appears, stop turning the screw.
segments.zh: 如果出现清晰的红点，就停止转动螺丝。

segments.text: Replace the welding wire.
segments.zh: 更换焊丝。

segments.text: Now we replace the 1 millimeter welding wire with a 1.2 millimeter welding wire.
segments.zh: 现在我们把 1 毫米焊丝换成 1.2 毫米焊丝。

segments.text: Open the door of the wire feeder, unscrew the cap and remove the sleeve.
segments.zh: 打开送丝机的门，拧下盖子，取下套筒。

segments.text: Open the two tensioners.
segments.zh: 打开两个压紧器。

segments.text: Rotate the wire spool clockwise to remove the wire from the wire feeding driver.
segments.zh: 顺时针转动焊丝盘，把焊丝从送丝驱动器中退出来。

segments.text: Take out the wire spool.
segments.zh: 取出焊丝盘。

segments.text: Bend the wire end and store it in the hole of the wire spool.
segments.zh: 把焊丝末端弯折，并把它收在焊丝盘的孔里。

segments.text: Remove the screws.
segments.zh: 拆下螺丝。

segments.text: Remove the current drive rolls.
segments.zh: 拆下当前的送丝轮。

segments.text: Remove the screws above the wire feeding driver.
segments.zh: 拆下送丝驱动器上方的螺丝。

segments.text: Take out the drive roll stored above the wire feeding driver.
segments.zh: 取出存放在送丝驱动器上方的送丝轮。

segments.text: Ensure that the size on the outer side of the drive rolls matches the welding wires diameter.
segments.zh: 确保送丝轮外侧标注的尺寸与焊丝直径相符。

segments.text: Install the new pair of drive rolls.
segments.zh: 装上新的一对送丝轮。

segments.text: Install the screws back.
segments.zh: 把螺丝装回去。

segments.text: Store the other pair of drive rolls above the wire feeding driver.
segments.zh: 把另一对送丝轮存放在送丝驱动器上方。

segments.text: Replace the 0.8 slash 1.0 nozzle with the provided 1.2 slash 1.6 wire feeding nozzle.
segments.zh: 把 0.8/1.0 的喷嘴换成随附的 1.2/1.6 送丝喷嘴。

segments.text: Install the new wire spool.
segments.zh: 装上新的焊丝盘。

segments.text: Install the sleeve back.
segments.zh: 把套筒装回去。

segments.text: Install the cap back.
segments.zh: 把盖子装回去。

segments.text: Take out the wire end.
segments.zh: 取出焊丝末端。

segments.text: Cut off the bent end of the wire.
segments.zh: 剪掉焊丝弯曲的末端。

segments.text: Thread the wire into the wire feeding driver.
segments.zh: 把焊丝穿入送丝驱动器。

segments.text: Press the wire slightly to make it pass through.
segments.zh: 轻轻按压焊丝，让它穿过去。

segments.text: Close the tensioners.
segments.zh: 合上压紧器。

segments.text: Rotate the tensioners knobs to adjust the wire feed tension.
segments.zh: 转动压紧器的旋钮来调节送丝张力。

segments.text: Press and hold the feed button on the wire feeder until the wire extends out from the nozzle.
segments.zh: 按住送丝机上的送丝按钮，直到焊丝从喷嘴伸出来。

segments.text: Maintenance and cleaning of the CNC cutter.
segments.zh: 数控切割机的维护与清洁。

segments.text: Clean the nozzle.
segments.zh: 清洁喷嘴。

segments.text: The nozzle can be very hot after processing.
segments.zh: 加工后喷嘴可能会非常烫。

segments.text: Wear heat resistant gloves before you touch it.
segments.zh: 触摸之前要戴上耐热手套。

segments.text: Clean the base plate.
segments.zh: 清洁底盘。

segments.text: Clean the base plate with an alcohol dipped lint free cloth when necessary.
segments.zh: 必要时，用蘸了酒精的无尘布清洁底盘。

segments.text: Clean the camera lens.
segments.zh: 清洁摄像头镜头。

segments.text: Clean the strip lights.
segments.zh: 清洁灯带。

segments.text: Clean the protective lid.
segments.zh: 清洁防护盖。

segments.text: Clean the fixture and the dust proof plate.
segments.zh: 清洁夹具和防尘板。

segments.text: Clean the slats.
segments.zh: 清洁支撑条。

segments.text: Clean the exhaust fan.
segments.zh: 清洁排风扇。

segments.text: Disassemble the exhaust fan.
segments.zh: 拆下排风扇。

segments.text: Clean the exhaust fan.
segments.zh: 清洁排风扇。

segments.text: Clean the base plate slides.
segments.zh: 清洁底盘滑轨。
